de: Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ created the earth. Adam and Eve were placed in the Garden of Eden - the first family, the first covenant.

blocks.t: The earth was created BY Christ. The Creation is the starting point of every family story.
The earth was created as the stage for the Atonement of Jesus Christ.

de: Adam and Eve partook of the fruit, bringing mortality. The Fall made the Atonement of Jesus Christ necessary.

blocks.t: Without the Fall there is no need for a Savior. The Fall is the reason Christ came.
The Fall was part of Heavenly Father's plan to give His children the opportunity to grow and return to Him.

de: Enoch built a city so righteous it was taken to heaven. He wept for the world and Heavenly Father wept with him.

blocks.t: Zion is the goal of the Restoration. Enoch's city will return when Christ comes again.

de: Heavenly Father called Noah to build an ark. The rainbow covenant is the first visible covenant sign in scripture.

blocks.t: Every rainbow a child sees connects to this covenant promise.

de: Heavenly Father called Abraham. The Abrahamic Covenant - that Abraham's seed would bless all nations - is the foundation of the gospel plan.

blocks.t: Galatians 3:16: the promised seed of Abraham is Jesus Christ. All nations blessed through Him.
The Abrahamic Covenant is the foundational promise the Restoration was built upon.

de: Abraham commanded to offer Isaac. At the last moment Heavenly Father provided a ram. Jesus said this pointed to his own sacrifice.

blocks.t: The father offering his beloved son on Mount Moriah foreshadows the Father offering His Beloved Son.

de: Joseph was sold by his brothers, falsely imprisoned, and rose to save nations from famine. Acts 7 connects Joseph to Christ as a type of the Messiah.

blocks.t: Joseph sold for silver, falsely accused, raised to save - the pattern of the Savior.

de: Heavenly Father called Moses to deliver Israel. Paul identifies the Passover lamb, manna, and water from the rock as types of Christ.

blocks.t: Paul writes: that Rock was Christ. The Exodus is saturated with types of Jesus Christ.

de: The young shepherd David faced Goliath with five stones and faith. One stone. The giant fell. The LST Five Stones framework is named after this story.

blocks.t: Five smooth stones - SPOT, NAME, FIND, FORK, CALM - named for this story.

de: King Solomon built the first permanent temple. Heavenly Father's glory filled the house. Archaeology confirms construction on the Temple Mount.

blocks.t: Every temple is a house of Heavenly Father where families are sealed.

de: Isaiah prophesied of the Messiah with extraordinary precision. The Dead Sea Scrolls confirm these prophecies predate Christ by centuries.

blocks.t: Isaiah 53 describes the Atonement 700 years before it happened - confirmed by the Dead Sea Scrolls.
Isaiah's prophecies preserved the hope of a Messiah through centuries of apostasy.

de: Who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this? Queen Esther risked her life to save the Jewish people.

blocks.t: Without Esther's courage, the lineage of Jesus Christ could have been destroyed.

de: Daniel survived the lions den and interpreted dreams predicting empires thousands of years into the future. Daniel 2 points to the Restoration.

blocks.t: Daniel 2 - the stone cut without hands = the restored gospel rolling to fill the whole earth.

de: The Son of Heavenly Father was born in Bethlehem to the Virgin Mary. Angels sang to shepherds. Wise men followed a star. The most important birth in all of human history.

blocks.t: Everything before this was preparation. Everything after is response.
Heavenly Father orchestrated 4000 years of history to bring this one moment.

de: Jesus Christ suffered in Gethsemane for the sins pains and sorrows of all humanity. He was crucified. He rose from the dead on the third day. This is the center of all history - the reason the earth was created the reason families can be sealed the reason every bedtime story matters.

blocks.t: The Atonement is the center of all human history. The reason the earth exists. The reason families can be together forever.
Every empire every war every invention every civilization before 30 AD was preparation. Everything after flows from this moment.

de: After His resurrection Jesus Christ appeared to thousands of Nephites. He blessed their children one by one and wept.

blocks.t: Christ is God of the whole earth. His visit to the Americas confirms this.

de: Paul traveled over 10000 miles to carry the gospel throughout the Roman Empire. His letters form the doctrinal backbone of the New Testament.

blocks.t: Roman roads made Paul's journeys possible. Heavenly Father prepared Roman infrastructure for the first missionary work.
Paul's missions planted the Church across the Mediterranean world within 15 years of the Resurrection.

de: Lehi dreamed of the Tree of Life. Nephi learned the tree represents the love of Heavenly Father and the Atonement of Christ.

blocks.t: The tree of life equals the love of Heavenly Father as expressed in the Atonement of Jesus Christ.

de: 1 Nephi 16:34 names Nahom. In 1999 altars bearing the inscription NHM dating to 700-500 BC were excavated in Yemen. Joseph Smith could not have known this name from any source in 1829.

blocks.t: The NHM altars are one of the strongest archaeological evidences for the Book of Mormon.

de: King Benjamin gathered all his people and taught the Atonement of Jesus Christ in such depth that the people fell to the earth and experienced a mighty change of heart.

blocks.t: King Benjamin's sermon is the most detailed pre-Christian description of the Atonement's transforming power.

de: We do not doubt our mothers knew it. Two thousand young men whose mothers had taught them faith went to war. Not one was slain.

blocks.t: The greatest tribute to righteous mothers in all scripture. LST equips the mothers of the next generation.

de: The Book of Mormon: Another Testament of Jesus Christ is published. Eleven witnesses who never recanted their testimonies testified of seeing and handling the gold plates.

blocks.t: The Book of Mormon is the keystone of the Restoration - Another Testament of Jesus Christ.

de: Fourteen-year-old Joseph Smith knelt in a grove of trees and prayed. Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ appeared to him as two distinct glorified embodied persons.

blocks.t: Every preparation in history led to this moment. 4000 years of work culminated here.
A 14-year-old boy asked a sincere question. Heavenly Father answered in person.

de: The Church of Jesus Christ is restored with six original members. All authority ordinances and organization of Christ's original church are restored.

blocks.t: The restoration of Christ's church is the culmination of 6000 years of preparation.

de: This is the right place. Brigham Young leads the pioneers into the Salt Lake Valley. Thousands crossed the plains by wagon and handcart.

blocks.t: Pioneer Days is celebrated every July 24 - the same time LST set up their very first vendor booth in Monticello Utah.

de: President Gordon B. Hinckley reads The Family: A Proclamation to the World at the General Relief Society Meeting. Signed by the First Presidency and the Quorum of the Twelve, it declares that marriage between a man and a woman is ordained of Heavenly Father, that gender is an essential characteristic of eternal identity and purpose, that the sacred powers of procreation are to be employed only between a man and a woman lawfully wedded, and that parents have a sacred duty to rear their children in love and righteousness. It closes with a warning that the disintegration of the family will bring upon individuals, communities, and nations the calamities foretold by ancient and modern prophets.

blocks.t: The Proclamation did not argue a case. It declared a doctrine — positively and completely — describing what a family is rather than responding point by point to what the world was becoming. That is why it has not needed revising. Every Little Scripture Travelers bedtime story is built on it.

When the Proclamation was issued, not one nation on earth and not one American state had legalized same-sex marriage. The Netherlands would become the first country six years later in 2001. Massachusetts the first state in 2003. The Supreme Court would rule nationwide in Obergefell in 2015 — twenty years after the Proclamation was read aloud in Salt Lake City. Heavenly Father had His prophets state the doctrine while the ground was still firm.

meta: Honolulu, Hawaii and Salt Lake City
de: In May 1991, three couples sued the State of Hawaii for marriage licenses in Baehr v. Lewin. That November the First Presidency issued a letter to all members reaffirming the doctrine of marriage — a document later described as reading like an early draft of the Proclamation. In May 1993 the Hawaii Supreme Court became the first state high court in the nation to rule that excluding same-sex couples from marriage could constitute discrimination, a decision widely credited with launching the national movement. Drafting of the Family Proclamation began in the fall of 1994. In February 1995 the Church petitioned to intervene in the Hawaii case. The Proclamation was read that September. Elder Dallin H. Oaks said in 2017 that the inspiration identifying the need for a proclamation on the family had come to Church leadership more than twenty-three years earlier.

blocks.t: This is the pattern of Ezekiel 33:2-6. The watchman is set upon the tower precisely so that he can see the sword while it is still far off — and blow the trumpet before it arrives. Seeing it early is not a coincidence to be explained away. It is the entire purpose of having watchmen.

Prophets are not surprised observers reacting to headlines. They are watchmen given sight. One state court case on an island in the Pacific was the first visible signal, and the response was not a narrow legal brief but a complete declaration of doctrine on marriage, gender, parenthood, and family — issued before the movement reached a single other jurisdiction on earth. And the Latter-day Saints were not alone on the tower. Rome had issued Familiaris Consortio in 1981, the Charter of the Rights of the Family in 1983, and the Letter to Families in 1994. Evangelical leaders had signed the Danvers Statement in 1987. Four declarations, three traditions, no shared authority between them — all warning in the same direction before the storm arrived. See the Christian History layer.

de: The United States Supreme Court rules 5-4 that the Fourteenth Amendment requires all states to license and recognize same-sex marriages. The decision came six years after the Netherlands became the first nation to legalize same-sex marriage in 2001, twelve years after Massachusetts became the first American state in 2003, and twenty years after The Family: A Proclamation to the World was read in Salt Lake City.

blocks.t: The Church has consistently taught that all people are children of Heavenly Father and are to be treated with love and respect, while also maintaining the doctrine of marriage set forth in the Proclamation. Both of those obligations are real, and holding them together is the work.

Twenty years separate the Proclamation from Obergefell. In 1995 the doctrine seemed so self-evident that some wondered why it needed stating at all. That is precisely what makes it prophetic — a trumpet sounded while the sword was still far off.

de: Sumer builds the first cities first writing system and first legal codes. Confirmed extensively by archaeology.

blocks.t: Abraham was born in Ur of the Chaldees - a Sumerian city. Heavenly Father placed the covenant family at the heart of the first civilization.

de: The Great Pyramid of Giza is completed - the most precisely engineered structure of the ancient world. Still standing after 4500 years.

blocks.t: The world was building monuments to earthly power. Heavenly Father was building something invisible - a covenant family that would bless all nations.

de: The Greek golden age produces democracy philosophy mathematics and the foundations of Western thought. The New Testament will be written in Greek.

blocks.t: The New Testament was written in Greek because of Greek civilization. Heavenly Father prepared Greek language as the vehicle for the gospel.

de: Martin Luther nails his 95 Theses. The Bible is translated into languages ordinary people can read.

blocks.t: The Reformation broke the monopoly on scripture. Without it individual Bible reading and private prayer leading to the First Vision would have been impossible.

de: The United States declares independence. The Constitution creates the legal framework for religious freedom. D&C 101:80 states the Constitution was established by wise men raised up by Heavenly Father.

blocks.t: The First Amendment is the legal reason Joseph Smith could kneel pray share his vision and found a church.
The United States was specifically prepared as the birthplace and home of the Restoration.

de: King John signs the Magna Carta - the first document establishing that the king is not above the law.

blocks.t: The Magna Carta begins the 600-year legal path to the First Amendment that protected Joseph Smith.
Magna Carta started the chain: English Bill of Rights - U.S. Constitution - First Amendment - Joseph Smith prays openly.

de: The First Amendment guarantees freedom of religion speech and assembly - the most expansive protection of individual conscience ever enacted.

blocks.t: The First Amendment is the legal reason Joseph Smith could kneel in a grove of trees share his vision and found a church.

de: Wycliffe Tyndale Luther and the King James Bible translate scripture into languages ordinary people can read. Tyndale was burned at the stake.

blocks.t: The Bible in common languages allowed ordinary families to read scripture personally and pray about what they read.

de: Egyptian Pharaoh Merneptah's stele records Israel is laid waste - the earliest known non-biblical reference to Israel as a people.

blocks.t: Critics who claimed Israel was invented by later writers were silenced by this stone. It proves Israel existed exactly when the Bible says.

t: Tel Dan Stele - House of David
de: Discovered in 1993 this inscription explicitly references the House of David - the first archaeological evidence of David's dynasty outside the Bible.

blocks.t: Critics who denied David's historical existence were silenced by this 1993 discovery.

de: The Dead Sea Scrolls are 1000 years older than previously known manuscripts. The Great Isaiah Scroll matches the current Bible with 95% accuracy.

blocks.t: The Scrolls confirm Isaiah was written before Christ - meaning Isaiah 53 predicts the Atonement 700 years before it happened.

de: A burial ossuary inscribed Joseph son of Caiaphas was discovered in Jerusalem in 1990 - the high priest who condemned Jesus.

blocks.t: His name is still on his burial box 2000 years later. The historical reality of Christ's trial is confirmed.

de: The single most transformative technology in human history. Fire enables cooking which grew the human brain.

blocks.t: Fire enabled the brain development that would one day allow humans to receive and reason about scripture.

de: Cuneiform writing invented in Sumer - confirmed by thousands of clay tablets. Without writing there is no scripture.

blocks.t: Writing is the invention that makes scripture possible. The word of Heavenly Father can now be preserved across generations.

de: Cai Lun invents paper in China. Paper eventually reaches Europe making books far cheaper and portable.

blocks.t: Paper made the scriptures portable. Every LST book is printed on paper - a Chinese invention from 105 AD.

de: The Bible is the first major book printed. Within 50 years 8 million books circulate in Europe.

blocks.t: The printing press put the Bible in ordinary homes. Personal scripture reading led to the First Vision.

de: Samuel Morse sends What hath God wrought - Numbers 23:23. The first words sent by electric communication were scripture.

blocks.t: The first telegraphed words were scripture. The telegraph enabled global coordination of the Lord's work.

de: Mark Zuckerberg launches Facebook. Within a decade 2 billion people use social media. Ordinary people can broadcast to the entire world instantly.

blocks.t: Social media has been used powerfully for missionary work. The same platforms are also engineered for addiction.

de: TikTok launches with the most sophisticated attention-capture algorithm ever built.

blocks.t: TikTok missionaries reach millions of young people. But the same algorithm pushes harmful content to vulnerable teens.

de: Judaism is the covenant faith from which Christianity traces its roots.

blocks.t: Every LST Old Testament story is a Jewish story. Christianity is the fulfillment of the covenant Heavenly Father made with Abraham.

de: Siddhartha Gautama teaches the path to end suffering through wisdom and compassion. Today approximately 500 million followers.

blocks.t: Buddhism's teaching of compassion echoes Christ's own ministry. Heavenly Father places seeds of light in every culture.

de: Muhammad receives revelations forming the Quran. Islam preserves ancient Greek knowledge during the Dark Ages.

blocks.t: Muslims believe Jesus was a prophet, but not that He is our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. They honor Him as a great prophet born of a virgin who did miracles, but they do not believe He is the Son of God who died for our sins and rose again. That is the great difference between Islam and Christianity.

de: Greek philosopher whose systematic thinking shaped Western civilization for 2000 years. Taught Alexander the Great.

blocks.t: Aristotle's logic provided the intellectual framework that Christian scholars used to articulate doctrine.

de: The ultimate Renaissance man - painter scientist inventor anatomist. His notebooks contain designs for flying machines centuries before their invention.

blocks.t: Leonardo's The Last Supper remains the most famous painting of Christ. His anatomical drawings advanced medicine.

de: Shakespeare wrote 37 plays and 154 sonnets that remain the most performed works in the English language.

blocks.t: Shakespeare wrote during the same decades as the King James Bible. His mastery of English helped create the literary atmosphere in which scripture was most beautifully expressed.

de: Newton discovered the laws of motion and gravity invented calculus and wrote more theology than physics.

blocks.t: Newton wrote: This most beautiful system could only proceed from the counsel and dominion of an intelligent Being. Reason and revelation are not enemies.

de: 16th President of the United States. Led the Union through the Civil War. Emancipation Proclamation. Assassinated 1865.

blocks.t: Lincoln's Second Inaugural Address identified the Civil War as God's judgment for the sin of slavery. He preserved the Constitution that protected religious freedom.

de: Einstein's theory of relativity revolutionized physics. E=mc2. Nobel Prize 1921.

blocks.t: Einstein said the most incomprehensible thing about the universe is that it is comprehensible. He saw mathematical order as evidence of a cosmic intelligence.

de: The Genesis Flood covers the earth. Noah, his family, and representatives of all animals survive on the ark. Every major civilization on earth preserves a flood narrative. The Gilgamesh Epic (Sumerian), Hindu Manu story, Chinese Nüwa legend, Mesoamerican and Native American flood accounts all share core elements with Genesis.

blocks.t: Noah is one of the greatest prophets in scripture. The flood demonstrates that Heavenly Father acts in human history and that covenant obedience is the only true safety. The rainbow covenant establishes the pattern of Heavenly Father making promises to His children after great trials.

The universality of flood narratives across cultures that had no contact with each other is among the strongest evidences that humanity shares a common ancestor and a common sacred history. We are all Noah's children.

de: The Minoan eruption of Thera (modern Santorini) is one of the largest volcanic events in human history - possibly the largest in the last 10,000 years. It devastated the Minoan civilization and may have triggered tsunamis across the eastern Mediterranean. Some scholars connect it to the Exodus plagues.

blocks.t: Some scholars propose the Thera eruption as a possible natural mechanism for some of the Exodus plagues - ash causing darkness, tsunami affecting the Red Sea. Heavenly Father can work through natural events to accomplish His purposes.
Whether or not it connects to the Exodus this eruption reshaped the eastern Mediterranean world and contributed to the conditions that made Israel's rise possible.

de: One of history's most catastrophic societal collapses. Within 50 years the Hittite Empire the Mycenaean Greeks the Ugaritic civilization and dozens of city-states collapse simultaneously. Causes debated: drought, earthquake swarms, Sea Peoples invasions, internal rebellions, or all combined.

blocks.t: The Bronze Age Collapse created the power vacuum that allowed Israel to establish the united monarchy under Saul, David, and Solomon. Without the collapse of surrounding empires the Davidic kingdom may never have emerged.
Heavenly Father used the collapse of mighty empires to create the conditions for Israel's golden age under David and Solomon - preparing the lineage and location from which Jesus Christ would come.

de: Mount Vesuvius erupts catastrophically burying Pompeii and Herculaneum under 4-6 meters of ash and pumice. Approximately 16,000 people die. The eruption occurred just 9 years after the Roman destruction of Jerusalem. Preserved ruins provide extraordinary evidence of Roman life in the New Testament era.

blocks.t: Pompeii's preservation gives us a window into exactly the Roman world Paul's missionary journeys passed through. The same year Vesuvius erupted the survivors of the Jewish War were rebuilding their lives after the Temple's destruction.
The preservation of Pompeii has provided archaeologists with detailed knowledge of Roman life, commerce, and culture - helping us understand the world the early church navigated.

de: A catastrophic earthquake destroys Antioch - one of the most important cities of the early Christian church. Between 250,000 and 300,000 people die. Antioch was where believers were first called Christians (Acts 11:26) and was Paul's home base for missionary journeys.

blocks.t: Antioch was the birthplace of the term Christian and the launch point of Paul's missionary journeys. Its destruction is a sobering reminder of the fragility of human civilization and the importance of building faith on eternal foundations not earthly ones.
Even as Antioch fell the doctrines Paul had proclaimed from its streets had spread throughout the Roman world. The Word of God proved more durable than the city that first received it.

de: The first bubonic plague pandemic strikes the Byzantine Empire at the height of Emperor Justinian's reign. Between 25-50 million people die - approximately 25% of the Mediterranean population. It strikes at the moment Justinian was on the verge of reunifying the Roman Empire.

blocks.t: The Plague of Justinian halted the last serious attempt to restore the Roman Empire and accelerated the political fragmentation of Europe - setting the stage for the rise of independent nations that would eventually include the United States.

The fragmentation of political power that the plague accelerated was part of Heavenly Father's preparation - no single empire would dominate the world when the Restoration came, allowing religious freedom to emerge.

de: One of the deadliest earthquakes in recorded history strikes the region around Aleppo Syria. Approximately 230,000 people are killed. The earthquake occurs during the Crusades and devastates both Christian and Muslim populations in the Holy Land region.

blocks.t: The earthquake struck during the Crusades - a period when both Christianity and Islam were engaged in violent conflict over the Holy Land. Natural disaster struck both sides equally, no respecter of human religious divisions.

History's great natural disasters have consistently reminded humanity that political and religious divisions mean nothing before the forces of the natural world - calling all people to remember their common humanity before Heavenly Father.

de: Bubonic plague kills between 75-200 million people worldwide - approximately one third of Europe's population in four years. It arrives in Europe through Crimean trade routes in October 1347. By 1351 entire villages have vanished. The psychological and social impact reshapes European civilization.

blocks.t: The Black Death profoundly disrupted the medieval Catholic Church - many clergy died, church authority was questioned, survivors sought direct personal relationships with God. This spiritual disruption contributed to the conditions that made the Reformation possible 170 years later.

The Black Death's devastating blow to institutional religion and social order created a longing for direct personal relationship with God and genuine spiritual authority - preparing European hearts for the Reformation and ultimately the Restoration.

de: The deadliest earthquake in recorded human history. Approximately 830,000 people die in Shaanxi Province China. Entire counties lose 60% of their population. The earthquake causes massive landslides, floods, and fires. It remains the single highest death toll earthquake in history.

blocks.t: The Shaanxi earthquake occurred as the Protestant Reformation was reshaping European Christianity. On the other side of the world 830,000 people died in a single morning - reminding us that Heavenly Father's care extends to all His children in every land.

China has historically been one of the most spiritually seeking civilizations on earth. The seeds of truth Heavenly Father planted in Confucian and Buddhist culture sustained hundreds of millions of people through centuries of suffering including events like this.

de: A catastrophic earthquake strikes Lisbon on All Saints Day - when most of the city is in church. Followed by tsunami and fire. 30,000-40,000 people die. The earthquake strikes the capital of one of the world's great Catholic empires on its most sacred holy day and ignites the Enlightenment's crisis of faith.

blocks.t: The Lisbon earthquake sparked the Enlightenment's most intense questioning of divine providence - Voltaire wrote Candide in direct response. The crisis of faith it triggered accelerated the drift from institutional religion that the Restoration would need to counter.

Heavenly Father does not cause suffering. But He works within suffering. The Enlightenment's honest questioning of why evil exists helped sweep away a corrupted institutional religion and prepare Europe and America for a more direct relationship with truth.

t: Tambora Eruption — Year Without a Summer
de: The largest volcanic eruption in recorded history. Mount Tambora on Sumbawa Island Indonesia erupts with the force of 170,000 Hiroshima bombs. 71,000 people die immediately. The ash cloud causes the Year Without a Summer in 1816 - crop failures, famine, and mass migration across Europe and North America.

blocks.t: The Year Without a Summer caused mass migration across New England - pushing families including Joseph Smith's family to western New York. The Smith family moved to the Palmyra area in 1817, one year after the famine. A volcanic eruption in Indonesia set the conditions for the First Vision.

Joseph Smith Sr. moved his family from Vermont to Palmyra New York in 1817 - driven in part by the crop failures of the Year Without a Summer caused by Tambora's eruption. Heavenly Father can work through a volcano on the other side of the world to position a family for the First Vision.

de: A potato blight destroys Ireland's primary food crop for seven consecutive years. Between 1 and 1.5 million Irish people die of starvation and disease. Another 1-2 million emigrate to America, Canada, and Australia. Ireland's population falls from 8 million to 5 million in seven years.

blocks.t: The Irish Famine drove millions to America - among them thousands of Irish converts to the Church of Jesus Christ who had heard the gospel through early LDS missionaries to Ireland. Many famine immigrants joined the pioneer exodus to Utah.

The Irish Famine is one of history's great tragedies. But from it came one of the largest waves of immigration to America - bringing thousands of seeking souls to the very nation where the Restoration had begun, where many found the gospel.

de: Krakatoa explodes with the force of 200 megatons - the loudest sound ever recorded in human history, heard 4,800 kilometers away in Australia and Rodrigues Island. The tsunami kills 36,000 people. The eruption lowers global temperatures for five years and produces vivid red sunsets worldwide.

blocks.t: Krakatoa occurred as the Church was establishing itself globally. The vivid red sunsets it produced across the Northern Hemisphere for two years were recorded by artists worldwide - including paintings that some researchers believe inspired Edvard Munch's The Scream.
The global reach of Krakatoa's effects - affecting temperatures and skies worldwide - demonstrated how interconnected the earth is. Heavenly Father created one earth for one human family.

de: The deadliest natural disaster in United States history. A Category 4 hurricane strikes Galveston Texas with a storm surge of 15 feet. Between 8,000 and 12,000 people die. The city of 37,000 loses one third of its population in a single night.

blocks.t: The Galveston Hurricane struck as Latter-day Saint missionaries were actively serving throughout the American South. Members of the Church in Texas gathered to help survivors regardless of faith. Disaster has always revealed the true character of a people.

Natural disasters consistently reveal Heavenly Father's plan at work through His covenant people - the commandment to mourn with those that mourn and comfort those that stand in need of comfort (Mosiah 18:9) is most visible in the aftermath of catastrophe.

de: A magnitude 7.9 earthquake strikes San Francisco at 5:12 AM. The resulting fires burn for three days and destroy 25,000 buildings. Between 3,000 and 6,000 people die. 300,000 of San Francisco's 410,000 residents are left homeless. It is the greatest urban disaster in American history to that point.

blocks.t: The San Francisco earthquake and fire occurred as the Church was establishing strong roots on the West Coast. The disaster prompted enormous humanitarian response from Church members - an early example of the kind of organized relief the Church would become known for.

The rebuilding of San Francisco after 1906 transformed California's economy and culture - contributing to the growth of the American West that would later become home to millions of Latter-day Saints.

de: The deadliest pandemic in recorded history. Between 50 and 100 million people die worldwide - more than died in World War I. It infects 500 million people - one third of the world's population at the time. It kills the young and healthy rather than the old and weak, reversing normal disease patterns.

blocks.t: The Spanish Flu killed missionary work temporarily as Church leaders suspended all missionary activities. Many missionaries themselves died. But the Church's organizational response to the pandemic laid groundwork for the welfare and humanitarian programs that would follow.

The Spanish Flu struck at the end of World War I - a moment when humanity had just demonstrated its capacity for industrial-scale killing. The combination of war and pandemic produced a generation that had seen the fragility of human civilization and were hungry for spiritual anchors.

t: China Floods — Deadliest Disaster in History
de: The 1931 Central China floods are considered the deadliest natural disaster in recorded human history. The Yellow River, Yangtze River, and Huai River all flood simultaneously. Between 1 and 4 million people die from flooding, disease, and subsequent famine. 53 million people are affected.

blocks.t: The 1931 floods struck as China was in political turmoil between nationalist and communist forces. The suffering of tens of millions of Chinese people who had no access to the gospel moved Latter-day Saint hearts to pray for the opening of China to missionary work.

China has remained largely closed to formal missionary work throughout the modern era. Yet Heavenly Father has not forgotten His children there - the seeds He planted in Chinese culture continue to sustain hundreds of millions of seeking souls.

de: The deadliest tropical cyclone ever recorded. Between 300,000 and 500,000 people die in what was then East Pakistan (modern Bangladesh) when a massive cyclone and storm surge strikes the Ganges-Brahmaputra delta. The disaster and the inadequate response by West Pakistan contributed to the Bangladesh Liberation War of 1971.

blocks.t: The Bhola Cyclone mobilized one of the first major international humanitarian responses in the modern era. The Church's Humanitarian Aid programs would later become a major responder to such disasters - with Latter-day Saint Charities operating in over 180 countries.

The scale of the Bhola disaster shocked the world and began the modern era of international disaster response - building the global humanitarian infrastructure that the Church's Humanitarian Aid would eventually join.

de: A magnitude 9.1 earthquake off the coast of Sumatra triggers the deadliest tsunami in recorded history. 227,898 people die across 14 countries including Indonesia Sri Lanka India Thailand and Somalia. 1.7 million people are displaced. The disaster mobilizes the largest humanitarian response in history.

blocks.t: The Church of Jesus Christ mobilized immediately - Church Humanitarian Services delivered millions of dollars in aid within days. Latter-day Saint missionaries and members in the affected regions were among the first responders. The disaster opened humanitarian access to previously closed areas.

The world's response to the 2004 tsunami showed humanity at its best - national boundaries dissolved as people around the world gave to help strangers on the other side of the earth. Heavenly Father's children revealed their family nature in the response to tragedy.

de: A magnitude 7.0 earthquake strikes Haiti 25 kilometers from Port-au-Prince. Between 100,000 and 316,000 people die - making it one of the deadliest earthquakes in recorded history relative to population. 1.5 million people are left homeless. The earthquake devastates the Western Hemisphere's poorest nation.

blocks.t: The Church of Jesus Christ had a significant presence in Haiti at the time. Latter-day Saint Humanitarian Services delivered over $14 million in aid. LDS missionaries and local members were actively involved in rescue and recovery. The disaster accelerated Church growth in Haiti in the years that followed.

Haiti's suffering is profound and ongoing. Yet the gospel has grown remarkably in Haiti - one of the poorest nations on earth has produced some of the most faithful Latter-day Saints. Heavenly Father's covenant people are found in every nation regardless of earthly circumstances.

de: At General Conference, President Russell M. Nelson announces a fundamental restructuring: the three-hour Sunday block is reduced to two hours, and gospel study moves to the home with a new unified curriculum called Come, Follow Me. His words: We have become accustomed to thinking of church as something that happens in our meetinghouses, supported by what happens at home. We need an adjustment to this pattern. It is time for a home-centered church, supported by what takes place inside our branch, ward and stake buildings. The change took effect January 2019.

blocks.t: Seventeen months later, every meetinghouse on earth closed. Families who had spent over a year learning to hold church at home already had the manual, the habit, and the confidence. The Church did not scramble to invent home worship during the pandemic — it had already been taught.

Prophets see ahead. Whether or not President Nelson knew what was coming, Heavenly Father did. The pattern in scripture is consistent: Joseph stored grain seven years before the famine; Noah built before the rain; Lehi left Jerusalem before it fell. Preparation always arrives before the need.

de: A novel coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) spreads worldwide. The WHO declares a pandemic on March 11, 2020. Roughly 7 million deaths are officially confirmed; excess-mortality studies estimate the true global toll considerably higher. Nations impose lockdowns of unprecedented scope — closing schools, businesses, borders, and houses of worship. It is the most globally disruptive event since the Second World War.

blocks.t: For the first time in the history of the restored Church, every temple on earth closed and every congregation stopped meeting. Yet the sacrament was administered in living rooms by fathers and sons, and the work of salvation continued. The pandemic proved that the Church is not a building.

Every prior generation faced plague — Justinian, the Black Death, the 1918 influenza. What made this one different was not the virus but the response: the first time in history that the healthy were confined alongside the sick, and the first time worship itself was widely suspended by law.

de: The First Presidency suspends all public gatherings of Church members worldwide — an action without precedent in the history of the restored Church. All temples close. Tens of thousands of missionaries are brought home or reassigned. The April 2020 General Conference is held without a congregation, where President Nelson reads the Proclamation on the Restoration and leads a worldwide Hosanna Shout. Two worldwide fasts are called, on March 29 and April 10, 2020.

blocks.t: Sacrament meeting moved into homes. Fathers and sons blessed and passed the sacrament at kitchen tables. Come, Follow Me — already in every home for over a year — became the Sunday curriculum. Families discovered that the home had been the center of the gospel all along.
The Church closed its buildings and did not lose its people. Because the pattern had been established in 2018 and practiced through 2019, the transition took days rather than months.

t: Religious Worship Before the Supreme Court
de: In several jurisdictions, houses of worship were held to stricter limits than comparable secular businesses. The Supreme Court ruled repeatedly that this violated the First Amendment. In Roman Catholic Diocese of Brooklyn v. Cuomo (November 2020), Justice Gorsuch wrote that people could gather in bus stations, laundromats, banks and liquor shops, and that no apparent reason existed why they could not gather under identical restrictions in churches or synagogues — calling it exactly the kind of discrimination the First Amendment forbids. The Court reached similar conclusions in South Bay United Pentecostal v. Newsom (February 2021) and Tandon v. Newsom (April 2021), the latter reaching even into private homes where Bible study was restricted.

blocks.t: The First Amendment — written in 1791 and identified in D&C 101:80 as established by wise men whom Heavenly Father raised up — was the protection that held. The legal shield prepared 229 years earlier did the work it was prepared to do.

This is why the Restoration required a nation with religious liberty written into its founding law. Not because Heavenly Father cannot protect His Church without it, but because He builds the protections before the pressure arrives.

de: School closures in many nations — and particularly in parts of the United States — extended far longer than in comparable countries. Data from 72 nations in the PISA study showed mathematics declines equivalent to roughly seven months of lost learning between 2018 and 2022. Research has linked extended closures to increased anxiety and depression, rising chronic absenteeism, developmental delays in young children, increased obesity, and higher rates of reported violence against children. Losses fell hardest on the poorest students, who had the least access to remote learning.

blocks.t: Children paid a large share of the cost of decisions made by adults, for a disease that posed them comparatively little direct risk. Every child kept from school, from friends, from normal childhood, was a child of Heavenly Father whose development mattered.

The families who came through best were consistently those with structure at home — regular routine, reading together, prayer, and parents present. What protected children was not policy. It was family.

de: Several claims made confidently early in the pandemic were later corrected by the same institutions that made them. On March 29, 2021, the CDC Director stated that vaccinated people do not carry the virus; the CDC walked this back within three days, and later data confirmed vaccinated people could contract and transmit the virus. The six-foot distancing rule was later acknowledged in congressional testimony to have lacked a firm empirical basis. Extensive surface disinfection was later judged largely unnecessary. Myocarditis in young males following mRNA vaccination — initially downplayed — was subsequently confirmed and added to labeling. The lab-leak hypothesis, publicly dismissed early on, is now considered plausible: the CIA, FBI, and Department of Energy lean toward a research-related origin, though all with low or moderate confidence, while four other agencies still lean toward natural origin. In July 2026, Senator Rand Paul released over 1,000 pages of Dr. Fauci daily journals; Dr. Fauci invoked the Fifth Amendment rather than answer questions about them.

blocks.t: Vaccines did substantially reduce severe illness and death, especially among the elderly — that finding has held. What did not hold was the certainty. The lesson is not that all experts lie. It is that institutions speaking with more confidence than their evidence supports will eventually forfeit the trust they need most.

Truth survives scrutiny; certainty without evidence does not. This is precisely why Moroni 10:4-5 invites every person to ask Heavenly Father directly rather than accept a claim because an authority asserted it. Personal revelation is not a substitute for learning — it is protection against being told what to think.

de: Marx and Engels propose abolishing private property the family as a social unit and religion. Communism directly counters the U.S. Constitution.

blocks.t: The Communist Manifesto appeared just 28 years after the First Vision. It attacked individual freedom the family and religion simultaneously.

de: The internet gives pornography unprecedented reach. The same technology carrying the gospel is weaponized against families.

blocks.t: PARENT ALERT: Talk to your children early. The battle for the family is fought primarily here now.

de: AI generates convincing fake videos and clones any voice. The ability to fabricate false evidence threatens the concept of truth itself.

blocks.t: When any video can be faked the only reliable anchor is the witness of the Holy Ghost - the one source of truth that cannot be counterfeited.

de: Levi - inspired by bedtime routines with his daughters in Monticello Utah - creates Little Scripture Travelers. A faith-based children's media brand turning scripture into bedtime wonder for families around the world.

blocks.t: Every great work begins with a family moment. This is your family's chapter in the great story Heavenly Father is writing.

de: A round thing that rolls. Carts, then chariots, then every machine that turns.

blocks.t: The wheel let people carry more than their arms could hold. Food reached hungry cities, families moved to new lands, and one day the wheel would carry scriptures and missionaries across the world.

de: Curved glass that brings far things close. Galileo pointed one at the sky and saw moons around Jupiter.

blocks.t: The heavens declare the glory of God, and the telescope let us read that declaration. The same glass, turned the other way, became the microscope and showed the tiny worlds that keep us alive.

de: Boiling water pushes a piston, and the piston turns a wheel. Trains, ships and factories that never got tired.

blocks.t: Steam shrank the world. Missionaries crossed oceans in weeks instead of months, and the Saints crossed a continent to gather. Work that broke backs could be done by a machine, so children could go to school.

de: Light on a treated plate makes a picture of exactly what was there. For the first time a face could be kept.

blocks.t: A photograph lets a child see the great-grandmother who prayed for them. Family history became something you could hold. Every face in your scrapbook is here because of this.

de: A voice turned into electricity and back into a voice. For the first time you could hear someone who was not in the room.

blocks.t: A grandmother's voice at bedtime from a thousand miles away. A prophet's voice reaching every home at once. The telephone gave families a way to stay close when life spread them out.

de: A glowing wire inside a glass bulb. Night stopped being dark, in every room, at the flip of a switch.

blocks.t: Light is the oldest sign of Heavenly Father's work: 'Let there be light.' Electric light let families read, study and gather after the sun went down, safely, and it lit the hospitals and schools that followed.

de: Voices and music sent through the air with no wire at all. One person speaks and a whole nation hears.

blocks.t: For the first time a sermon, a prophet, a hymn could reach every home at the same moment. General Conference, missionary broadcasts and the gospel in a hundred languages all ride on radio.

de: Pictures shown fast enough that they seem to move. A story you can watch with a crowd.

blocks.t: Stories are how Jesus taught. A moving picture can carry a parable into a heart that will not sit still for a sermon. The Church's films, and every good family movie, stand here.

de: Movies and radio together, in a box in the living room. The world came into the house.

blocks.t: Television carried General Conference and the words of prophets into homes that could never travel to hear them. It let a family see the world Heavenly Father made, from the ocean floor to the moon.

de: A machine that follows instructions, millions of times a second. It counts, sorts, remembers and draws.

blocks.t: Family history, scripture search, the app you are reading this in: all of it is a computer keeping track of what matters. It was built to think fast so that people could spend their thinking on what only people can do.

de: A game you play on a screen. Pong, then Mario, then whole worlds.

blocks.t: Play is how children learn. A good game teaches patience, problem-solving and teamwork, and a family that plays together laughs together. Games can be built to teach anything, including scripture.

de: A computer small and cheap enough to sit on a family's desk.

blocks.t: Family history left the archives and came home. A parent could type the family's stories, print a lesson, and keep the records Heavenly Father asked us to keep, in the kitchen.

de: Sumerian cuneiform is the earliest known writing system — wedge-shaped marks pressed into clay tablets. It began as an accounting system in the temples of Uruk. Within centuries it was used to record literature law and eventually religion. The Epic of Gilgamesh — containing a flood narrative remarkably similar to Noah's — is among its earliest literary works.

blocks.t: Writing made scripture possible. Before language could be written down the words of prophets could only travel as far as human memory. Sumerian writing was the first brick Heavenly Father laid in building a world that could carry His word across time.

The flood narrative in Sumerian literature preserves a cultural memory of Noah's flood from the perspective of survivors in Mesopotamia — the same region Abraham came from. Heavenly Father's dealings with humanity left traces in every writing system.

de: Egyptian hieroglyphics develop alongside Sumerian as one of the earliest writing systems. Unlike Sumerian cuneiform hieroglyphics were carved in stone on temple walls and written on papyrus. The Merneptah Stele (c. 1208 BC) contains the earliest known external reference to Israel by name.

blocks.t: Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians (Acts 7:22) — including hieroglyphics. The scripture he wrote in Hebrew was composed by a man fluent in one of history's greatest writing traditions. Heavenly Father prepared His prophet in Egypt's schools.

The Rosetta Stone — discovered 1799 — allowed scholars to decode hieroglyphics and read ancient Egyptian records that confirmed biblical accounts. Heavenly Father preserved evidence of His dealings with Israel in the records of their oppressors.

de: Hebrew emerges as the sacred language of the covenant people. The entire Old Testament — the Torah the Prophets and the Writings — is written in Hebrew. Hebrew is unique among ancient languages: it went dormant as a spoken tongue for approximately 1,700 years and was then miraculously revived in the 19th-20th centuries as the national language of modern Israel.

blocks.t: Hebrew is the language in which Heavenly Father gave the Law to Moses Isaiah wrote his prophecies and David wrote the Psalms. The revival of Hebrew as a spoken language in Israel is itself a fulfilled prophecy (Zephaniah 3:9). The Book of Mormon was written in reformed Egyptian — a form related to these ancient writing traditions.

Hebrew's revival after 1,700 years of dormancy — through the single-handed work of Eliezer Ben-Yehuda — is the only successful large-scale language revival in human history. Today 9 million people speak Hebrew — fulfilling Zephaniah 3:9 written 2,600 years ago.

t: Greek — Language of the New Testament
de: Koine Greek — common Greek — becomes the universal language of the Mediterranean world through Alexander the Great's conquests. The Septuagint (Greek translation of the Hebrew Old Testament c. 250 BC) makes scripture available to Jews throughout the diaspora. The entire New Testament is written in Koine Greek.

blocks.t: The precision and vocabulary of Greek made it the ideal vehicle for expressing the doctrines of the New Testament. Words like grace (charis) repentance (metanoia) baptism (baptizo) gospel (euangelion) and logos (word) carry nuances in Greek that shaped Christian theology for 2,000 years.

John 1:1 — In the beginning was the Logos — is unintelligible without Greek philosophical context. Heavenly Father prepared Greek thought and Greek language so that when the New Testament was written the words already existed to express what needed to be said.

t: Latin — Language of the Church Age
de: Latin becomes the official language of the Roman Empire and subsequently the language of the Catholic Church for 1,500 years. Jerome translates the Bible into Latin (the Vulgate c. 382-405 AD) — the definitive Bible of Western Christianity for over 1,000 years. All official church documents theology and liturgy are conducted in Latin.

blocks.t: Latin's role as the Church's universal language both unified Western Christianity and created barriers. When Luther insisted on preaching in German and Tyndale died for translating the Bible into English they were breaking Latin's monopoly — democratizing access to scripture in preparation for the Restoration.

The very barrier that Latin created — keeping scripture from ordinary people — became the engine of the Reformation. Heavenly Father worked through Latin's dominance and then through its overthrow to move the world toward a day when every person could read scripture in their own tongue.

de: The Arabic language spreads with Islam across the Middle East North Africa and Spain. Arabic scholars translate and preserve the works of Greek philosophers — Aristotle Plato Euclid Ptolemy — that would otherwise have been lost in the collapse of Rome. The House of Wisdom in Baghdad (c. 800 AD) produces the world's most advanced scholarship in mathematics medicine astronomy and philosophy.

blocks.t: The Greek philosophical vocabulary that Arabic scholars preserved through the Dark Ages was the same vocabulary Western theologians later used to articulate Christian doctrine. Heavenly Father preserved Greek thought through Arabic scholarship so that the Renaissance could recover it.

Arabic numerals (actually Indian in origin but transmitted through Arabic) give us the number system we use today. Arabic scholarship preserved knowledge through centuries when Europe had nearly lost it. Heavenly Father used Islamic civilization to keep human knowledge alive for the Restoration era.

de: John Wycliffe produces the first complete English translation of the Bible from the Latin Vulgate. His followers the Lollards hand-copy and distribute it across England despite fierce opposition. Wycliffe argues that scripture in the people's language is the foundation of true religion. He is called the Morning Star of the Reformation.

blocks.t: When Joseph Smith read James 1:5 in his family's English Bible it was the spiritual descendant of Wycliffe's translation. The chain from Wycliffe to Tyndale to the King James Bible to the farmhouse in Palmyra to the grove of trees is direct and unbroken.

Wycliffe died before his opponents could burn him — they exhumed his body 44 years after his death and burned it anyway. His translator's courage was not in vain. The English Bible he began is the most widely distributed book in history.

de: Martin Luther translates the complete Bible into German — New Testament in 1522 complete Bible in 1534. His German is so vivid and accessible that it helps standardize the German language itself. He uses the language of the market and the home not the university. Within years every German household that could afford one had a Luther Bible.

blocks.t: Luther's German Bible established the principle that Heavenly Father's word belongs in the language of the family — not locked behind a sacred tongue. This principle drives every missionary program: the gospel must be spoken in the language of the people.
The Book of Mormon has been translated into 112 languages. Each translation carries on the tradition Luther established — that Heavenly Father's word belongs in every mother tongue.

de: King James I commissions 47 scholars to produce a new English Bible translation. The resulting King James Version becomes the most influential book in the English language — shaping literature politics and religion for 400 years. Its language enters the English-speaking world so deeply that phrases from it are still used daily.

blocks.t: Joseph Smith read James 1:5 in the King James Bible. The First Vision. The Restoration. The translation of the Book of Mormon into English. All of it happened in the language shaped by this translation. The King James Bible is the single most important book in the Restoration preparation chain after scripture itself.

The Book of Mormon was translated into King James English by Joseph Smith — not because it was written in that style but because the Spirit translated it in the sacred language register that English-speaking people associated with Heavenly Father's word. 47 scholars and one prophet — both tools in Heavenly Father's hands.

de: Modern linguistics identifies approximately 7,000 living languages worldwide. The Bible has been translated into over 3,500 languages. The Book of Mormon into 112. The Church conducts meetings in 188 languages. Wycliffe Bible Translators is working on the remaining languages that still lack scripture.

blocks.t: Pentecost in Acts 2 was the sign that the gospel was for all languages and peoples: every man heard them speak in his own language (Acts 2:6). The Restoration has carried that Pentecost promise into 188 languages and counting. The gift of tongues is still being poured out.

Acts 2:8 — how hear we every man in our own tongue? — is still being fulfilled. Heavenly Father wants every one of His children to hear His word in their mother tongue. That work is still ongoing and will not be finished until every kindred tongue and people has heard the gospel.

de: Genetic and archaeological evidence suggests the human population may have bottlenecked to as few as 10,000-100,000 individuals at points in prehistory. Modern genetics suggests all living humans descend from a remarkably small founding population — consistent with the biblical understanding of common ancestry.

blocks.t: From a handful of Heavenly Father's children to 8 billion today. Every person who has ever lived is a child of Heavenly Father. The population story is the story of a family growing.
Modern genetics has confirmed what scripture always taught: all humans share a common ancestry. We are literally one family.

de: Population estimates for the ancient world vary widely. By Noah's time scholars estimate between 5 and 20 million people on earth — mostly concentrated in the Fertile Crescent Egypt and the Indus Valley. The flood narrative and the Table of Nations in Genesis 10 describe the repopulation of the earth from Noah's family.

blocks.t: Genesis 10 — the Table of Nations — lists 70 nations descended from Noah's three sons. Modern scholarship has found these broadly correspond to the ancient world's major ethnic and linguistic groups. We are all children of Noah.
The Table of Nations in Genesis is one of the earliest attempts at a comprehensive account of human diversity and unity — all people from one family through one covenant man.

de: By the time of David and Solomon approximately 50 million people lived on earth. The major civilizations of Egypt Mesopotamia China and the Indus Valley were flourishing. The Israelite nation was at its political peak under Solomon. The population was heavily concentrated in the river valley civilizations.

blocks.t: 50 million people on earth — and Heavenly Father had placed His covenant people in one of the most strategically located spots on the globe. Israel sat at the crossroads of three continents — exactly where the gospel would one day spread in every direction.

Heavenly Father did not place His covenant people in an isolated corner. He placed them at the crossroads of the ancient world — where merchants traveled, where armies marched, where ideas spread. The location of Israel is deliberate.

de: At the time of Christ's birth approximately 300 million people lived on earth. The Roman Empire alone contained perhaps 70 million. China under the Han Dynasty had a similar population. The Americas the Pacific Islands and sub-Saharan Africa contained the remainder. The known world was more connected than ever before through Roman roads and Mediterranean trade.

blocks.t: 300 million people on earth when Jesus was born. By 100 AD the gospel had reached every corner of the Roman Empire through the missionary journeys of Paul and the other apostles. The speed of the gospel's first spread has never been equaled.

In one generation — 30 years — the gospel went from 12 disciples in Jerusalem to thriving communities in Rome Corinth Ephesus Antioch and North Africa. 300 million people and the gospel was already reaching them.

de: The Black Death (1347-1351) killed approximately 75-200 million people — reducing Europe's population by one third. The world population which had reached 450 million fell dramatically and did not recover pre-plague levels until after 1500. The trauma reshaped European civilization and accelerated the conditions for the Reformation.

blocks.t: The Black Death struck and the population fell — but the hunger for God increased. In the aftermath of mass death people searched for spiritual meaning as never before. The Reformation and eventually the Restoration emerged from a civilization that had learned that human institutions fail and earthly life is fragile.

Population decline from the Black Death created the spiritual crisis that cracked open medieval Christianity. Heavenly Father worked through demographic catastrophe to prepare European hearts for the Reformation that would prepare the world for the Restoration.

de: Earth reaches 1 billion humans for the first time around 1804. It took all of human history to reach the first billion. The milestone occurs as the Industrial Revolution is transforming Europe and America — and just 16 years before the First Vision. The printing press steam power and mass literacy are combining to create a world capable of receiving the Restoration.

blocks.t: The Church of Jesus Christ was organized in 1830 — when the world had approximately 1 billion people. Joseph Smith received the First Vision in 1820. The Restoration began at the exact moment the world reached its first billion — and the tools to reach them (printing press railroads telegraph) were all arriving simultaneously.

Heavenly Father did not launch the Restoration into a world of 10 million people living in isolated villages. He launched it into a world of 1 billion — connected by printing presses railroads and eventually telegraph — so the gospel could go to all nations in one generation.

de: Earth reaches 2 billion people in 1927. It took 123 years to go from 1 to 2 billion. The Church had grown from 6 members in 1830 to approximately 650,000 by 1927 — present in North America Europe and the Pacific Islands. The automobile radio and global communication were transforming how information spread.

blocks.t: Between 1830 and 1927 the Church grew from 6 to 650,000 members while the world's population doubled. The ratio of Latter-day Saints to total world population was still tiny — but the infrastructure of the Restoration (temples missionary program General Conference) was firmly established.

1927 — radio broadcasting begins carrying voices around the world. General Conference could now be heard beyond the walls of the Tabernacle. Heavenly Father's pattern: as the world's population grows He provides new tools to reach them.

de: Earth reaches 3 billion in 1960 — only 33 years after reaching 2 billion. The post-World War II baby boom in America and improved medicine worldwide accelerated population growth dramatically. The Church had approximately 1.7 million members — present in dozens of countries. Television was transforming how people received information.

blocks.t: The correlation program of the Church — standardizing curriculum worldwide — was introduced in the 1960s as the Church became a truly global institution. As the world's population accelerated Heavenly Father organized His Church to reach it.

The same generation that saw the world reach 3 billion also saw the Church begin its modern international expansion — the correlation program jet travel and translation programs all arriving simultaneously to help the gospel keep pace with population growth.

de: Earth reaches 5 billion on July 11 1987 — designated World Population Day by the United Nations. The Church had approximately 6.4 million members. The Church's missionary program was sending missionaries to more countries than ever before. The Berlin Wall would fall two years later opening Eastern Europe.

blocks.t: The Church reached 6 million members the same decade the world reached 5 billion. The gospel was spreading at an unprecedented rate — but so was the world's population. Heavenly Father's commission to take the gospel to every nation is a moving target.

1987 — the personal computer was transforming how information was stored and shared. The same decade brought both the 5 billion population milestone and the beginning of the digital revolution that would eventually produce the internet and global gospel access.

de: Earth reaches 7 billion on October 31 2011. The Church had approximately 14 million members. Facebook had 800 million users. The Arab Spring was using social media to reshape the Middle East. The world was more connected than at any point in history — and also more spiritually searching.

blocks.t: 7 billion people and the Church has 14 million members — approximately 0.2% of the world's population. The harvest is plenteous but the laborers are few (Matthew 9:37). The work of the Restoration has barely begun.

The internet FamilySearch social media and translation technology arrived at exactly the moment the world's population hit 7 billion. Heavenly Father is not behind. He is ahead. Every tool the world needs to hear the gospel is arriving faster than ever.

de: Earth reaches 8 billion on November 15 2022. Growth is slowing — projections suggest Earth will peak around 10-11 billion later this century before leveling off. The Church has approximately 17 million members. AI is beginning to transform how information is processed and shared.

blocks.t: 8 billion children of Heavenly Father alive at the same time. Every one of them His beloved child. Every one of them deserving to hear the gospel in their own language. The vision of Revelation 14:6 — the angel flying in the midst of heaven having the everlasting gospel to preach unto every nation kindred tongue and people — is being fulfilled in our generation.

Every technology Heavenly Father prepared — writing printing press railroads telegraph radio television internet AI — was designed for this moment: 8 billion of His children all alive at once all reachable through the same global network that now connects every human on earth.

de: Uruk in ancient Mesopotamia is considered the world's first true city — reaching a population of perhaps 80,000 by 2800 BC. It had monumental architecture a temple complex the first writing system and organized commerce. The biblical Nimrod founded a kingdom whose first city was Babel (Genesis 10:10).

blocks.t: The first cities emerge in the same region where Abraham lived — the Fertile Crescent where civilization writing and the covenant people all appeared together. Heavenly Father's dealings with humanity are rooted in the world's first cities.

Urban civilization concentrated human knowledge, writing, and commerce in ways that made scripture possible. The same cities that produced the first writing produced the first records of Heavenly Father's dealings with humanity.

de: Memphis was the capital of ancient Egypt for over 1,000 years — the most powerful city in the ancient world during the Pyramid Age. The pyramids at Giza were built to serve Memphis. Abraham visited Egypt. Joseph was sold into slavery and rose to power in Egypt. Moses was born and raised near Memphis.

blocks.t: Three of the Old Testament's most important figures — Abraham Joseph and Moses — all had their destinies shaped by Egypt and its capital. Heavenly Father placed His servants at the center of the world's greatest early civilization.

Joseph in Egypt is one of scripture's greatest stories of Heavenly Father's providence. Sold into slavery by his brothers he became second only to Pharaoh — positioned to save his family and preserve the covenant lineage through seven years of famine.

t: Jerusalem — City of the Great King
de: David conquers Jerusalem and makes it his capital c. 1000 BC. Solomon builds the First Temple there. It becomes the spiritual center of the covenant people. The Psalms are composed there. The prophets preach there. Jesus is crucified there. Peter preaches there at Pentecost. Jerusalem is the single most fought-over city in human history — subject to at least 44 sieges.

blocks.t: Jerusalem is the city Heavenly Father chose as the center of His covenant with Israel. The temple He commanded to be built there was the pattern for temple worship in the restored gospel. Jesus died and rose again there. The New Jerusalem — the eternal city — will one day descend near the city named after the old Jerusalem's peace.

Every great world empire has marched through Jerusalem: Egyptian Assyrian Babylonian Persian Greek Roman Byzantine Arab Crusader Ottoman and British. No other city has attracted the sustained attention of so many powers for so many centuries. Heavenly Father placed His earthly home in a city the whole world cannot leave alone.

de: Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar II becomes the greatest city on earth — perhaps 200,000 people, the Hanging Gardens, the Ishtar Gate, ziggurats and canals. It destroys Jerusalem sacks the Temple and carries Israel into captivity. Daniel Shadrach Meshach and Abednego serve in its courts. Isaiah names Cyrus as its conqueror 150 years before it happens.

blocks.t: Babylon in scripture becomes the symbol of worldly power opposed to Heavenly Father — Revelation calls the wicked world Babylon the Great. Daniel's testimony in Nebuchadnezzar's court is one of the greatest examples of covenant faithfulness under pressure in all of scripture.

Heavenly Father placed His greatest prophets in the greatest city of their day — Daniel in Babylon as He had placed Joseph in Egypt. His servants are not hidden in safe corners. They are placed at the center of power to testify.

de: Athens in the 5th century BC is the intellectual capital of the world — producing Socrates Plato Aristotle Sophocles Herodotus and Thucydides in a single century. Its democratic ideals its philosophical vocabulary and its artistic achievements shape Western civilization for 2,500 years.

blocks.t: Paul preached on Mars Hill in Athens (Acts 17) — directly engaging Greek philosophy. He quoted Greek poets to make his case for the resurrection. The philosophical vocabulary Athens created became the language in which Christian theology was articulated. Heavenly Father used Athens's intellectual legacy.

Acts 17:23 — Paul in Athens sees an altar To the Unknown God and declares: what you worship in ignorance I now proclaim to you. Heavenly Father had placed a hunger for Him even in the world's most philosophical city. Seeds of truth in the home of Plato.

de: Rome at its peak is a city of perhaps 1 million people — the largest city in the Western world for centuries. Its roads its law its language and its organization shape every civilization that follows. Peter and Paul both die in Rome. The early church thrives under persecution then becomes Rome's official religion. The Vatican — Christendom's capital — sits in Rome to this day.

blocks.t: Heavenly Father used Roman infrastructure — roads Pax Romana common language — to spread the gospel throughout the known world in one generation. Peter and Paul both carried the gospel to Rome and sealed their testimony with their blood in the city that had tried to extinguish it.

Rome's fall in 476 AD ended the political empire but not the city's influence. The Catholic Church preserved Roman law organization and Latin culture through the Dark Ages from its seat in Rome. Heavenly Father used the city that martyred His apostles to preserve the civilization that would produce the Reformation.

de: Constantine founds Constantinople in 330 AD as the new capital of the Roman Empire — strategically located at the crossroads of Europe and Asia. It becomes the greatest city in Christendom for over 1,000 years — center of the Byzantine Empire and Eastern Orthodox Christianity. The Hagia Sophia (537 AD) is its crowning architectural achievement. It falls to the Ottoman Turks in 1453.

blocks.t: Constantinople's fall in 1453 sent Greek scholars fleeing to Western Europe with ancient manuscripts — directly triggering the Renaissance and the recovery of classical learning that fueled the Reformation. Heavenly Father used a city's fall to scatter seeds of knowledge across Europe.

The fall of Constantinople accelerated the Renaissance which produced the printing press era which produced the Reformation which produced the conditions for the Restoration. A city's fall in 1453 is connected to a boy kneeling in a grove of trees in 1820.

de: Baghdad under the Abbasid Caliphate becomes the world's largest city — perhaps 1 million people at its peak in the 9th century. The House of Wisdom translates Greek Roman and Indian scientific and philosophical works into Arabic preserving them during Europe's Dark Ages. Algebra geometry astronomy medicine — Baghdad advances them all.

blocks.t: The knowledge Baghdad preserved — Greek philosophy mathematics and science — was the intellectual foundation of the European Renaissance. Heavenly Father kept human knowledge alive in Baghdad while Europe struggled so that the Renaissance could recover it for the Reformation era.

Algebra (from the Arabic al-jabr) and the number zero (transmitted through Arabic from India) are among Baghdad's gifts to the world. Every calculation made with modern mathematics passes through Baghdad's scholars. Heavenly Father used Islamic civilization to carry human knowledge across the Dark Ages.

t: London — Capital of the Reformation World
de: London grows from a medieval city to the world's largest city by 1800 — capital of the British Empire and center of the English-speaking world. The King James Bible is produced in London. The Puritans sail from its ports. The Industrial Revolution begins in its factories. The British Empire carries the English language to every continent.

blocks.t: The King James Bible was commissioned in London. The Pilgrims sailed from Southampton near London. The English language that would carry the Restoration — the Book of Mormon the sermons of Joseph Smith the scripture of the Doctrine and Covenants — was shaped in London. Heavenly Father prepared a global language through a global empire.

English today is spoken by approximately 1.5 billion people as a first or second language. The gospel in English reaches more people than any other single language. London's empire — whatever its flaws — spread the language Heavenly Father chose for the Restoration.

de: Philadelphia is the city where the Declaration of Independence was signed in 1776 and where the Constitution was written in 1787. The most consequential political documents in American history were drafted here — establishing the religious liberty that made the Restoration legally possible.

blocks.t: D&C 101:80 identifies the Constitution's framers as wise men Heavenly Father raised up. The First Amendment they wrote in Philadelphia is the legal foundation on which Joseph Smith built the Church and on which the missionary program rests.

Philadelphia in Greek means brotherly love. The city of brotherly love produced the documents that guaranteed religious freedom — the condition Heavenly Father required before launching the Restoration. Heavenly Father placed the right men in the right city at the right moment.

de: Palmyra New York — a small frontier town of perhaps 4,000 people in 1820 — becomes the most important city in the Restoration. A grove of trees near the Smith family farm is the site of the First Vision. The Book of Mormon plates are buried in the nearby Hill Cumorah. The Book of Mormon is first printed in Palmyra by E.B. Grandin.

blocks.t: Heavenly Father did not begin the Restoration in London Paris or Rome. He began it in a frontier town in western New York — among ordinary farming families who read the Bible prayed sincerely and were not encumbered by centuries of institutional tradition. Heavenly Father chooses the weak things of the world to confound the mighty.

Palmyra sits in the Erie Canal corridor — the commercial highway that connected the American frontier to the eastern seaboard. The Book of Mormon was printed in Palmyra and could be distributed quickly throughout the entire eastern United States via the canal. Even the geography of the Restoration was deliberate.

t: Salt Lake City — City of the Saints
de: Brigham Young leads the pioneer companies into the Salt Lake Valley and declares: This is the right place. Drive on. In an uninhabited desert valley the Saints build a city — the Salt Lake Temple at its center — that becomes the headquarters of the global Church. From a valley surrounded by mountains the Restoration expands to every nation on earth.

blocks.t: The Salt Lake Valley was chosen by revelation — a place where the Saints could build in peace until the Church was strong enough to go to every nation. Today Salt Lake City is the headquarters of a 17-million member global faith. Heavenly Father chose a desert valley as the launching pad for the final dispensation.

The Salt Lake Temple begun in 1853 and completed in 1893 — forty years of building — stands as the visible symbol of the Restoration's permanence. From this valley the temple program has expanded to over 300 temples on every inhabited continent. The city in the desert became the spiritual capital of the world for Heavenly Father's covenant people.

de: Pope John Paul II issues the Apostolic Exhortation Familiaris Consortio, On the Role of the Christian Family in the Modern World. Following the 1980 Synod of Bishops on the family, it sets out a comprehensive Catholic theology of marriage and family: the family as a communion of persons, marriage as an indissoluble covenant between one man and one woman, the family as a servant of life, and the family as the domestic church. It remains the foundational modern Catholic document on the family.

blocks.t: Pope John Paul II
The first comprehensive papal treatment of marriage and family in the modern era. Fourteen years before the Family Proclamation.

Different tradition, different authority, remarkably similar substance. John Paul II described the family as the domestic church — the same principle President Nelson would later teach as home-centered, Church-supported.

t: Charter of the Rights of the Family
meta: Roman Catholic - Holy See · Vatican City
de: The Holy See presents the Charter of the Rights of the Family to all persons, institutions and authorities concerned with the mission of the family in the world. Written in the format of a formal declaration, it affirms that the family is based on marriage, that marriage is a natural institution to which the mission of reproduction is entrusted, and that the family exists before the State and is a natural society with inalienable rights that no government confers and none may remove.

blocks.t: Pontifical Council for the Family, under Pope John Paul II
A formal charter declaring family rights as prior to and independent of the State. Twelve years before the Family Proclamation.

The Charter declares that the family exists before the State. The Family Proclamation declares that the family is ordained of Heavenly Father. Both are saying that the family is not a construct of government and therefore cannot be redefined by it.

de: The newly formed Council on Biblical Manhood and Womanhood meets in Danvers, Massachusetts and drafts a statement of affirmations on gender and family, published in final form in November 1988. It affirms that both Adam and Eve were created in the image of God, equal before God as persons and distinct in their manhood and womanhood, and that distinctions in masculine and feminine roles are ordained by God as part of the created order. Its preamble names the widespread ambivalence regarding the values of motherhood and vocational homemaking, and the accommodation of some within the church to the spirit of the age.

blocks.t: Council on Biblical Manhood and Womanhood; John Piper and Wayne Grudem among the drafters

An evangelical declaration on gender as created and given rather than chosen. Eight years before the Family Proclamation and roughly three decades before gender identity became a central public debate.
